prose: A post on personal AI agents such as Meta's Muse, OpenAI's dots and Instinct argues that websites will soon ask which agent is acting and whether a real person started the action. It presents World ID as a way for an agent to prove a human is behind it while keeping personal details private. Only the opening was read.
highlights: Sites will ask which agent is calling and whether a human is behind it.
World ID proposed as the proof of personhood.
